values: Proposed planning baseline, prepared 17 October 2026. Dates and owners are not yet approved.
Year 1 = M1–M12; Year 2 = M13–M24. All activity windows include both start and end months.
Phase 0 weeks 1–6 mapped to M1–M2. Phase 1 M2–M4; Phase 2 M5–M9; Phase 3 M10–M18 follow the vault.
Within-phase task dates, equipment commissioning and all M19–M24 dates are proposed. The expense workbook specifies years, not monthly timing.
App, API, staff console and care-loop prototype already exist as of 16 October. M1–M2 covers completion and validation for real use.
Current .brain and implementation supersede older handoff snapshots. Research informs scope, not confirmed delivery dates.
Annual amounts support workstreams. No monthly cost allocation or grant disbursement schedule is inferred. Blank Year 2 costs remain blank.
Budget funds 16 enumerators/digitizers across four LGUs once in Year 1. Service rollout starts with one LGU; survey geography requires confirmation.
Budget row 44 says Twenty (25) kits; row 42 says Two (3) printers. Amounts imply 25 kits and 3 printers. Confirm quantities.
Year 2 has no new enumerator line or explicit domain / office-supply renewal. Confirm internet provision covers Starlink service.
Listed expenses exceed the stated Year 1 total by PHP 38,000; Year 2 detail is PHP 780,000 below the stated total. Figures are preserved.
IDs describe prerequisites or coordination links. Same-month work needs within-month sequencing. Gates require evidence before expansion.
Edit amber Start/End month cells on the Gantt (1–24). Duration, bars and milestone position update. Dependencies do not auto-reschedule.
Weekly pilot reviews and quarterly quality / finance reviews are continuous work windows, not separate monthly spending commitments.
